name: Art Agent
description: Select a block structure in the editor, describe how it should look, and an AI agent drafts the decoration right in your level.

api-key.name: Gemini API Key
api-key.description: Free key from aistudio.google.com (Get API key). Stored locally. If dots or underscores get dropped, put the key in api-key.txt inside the mod's save folder instead.

model.name: Gemini model
model.description: Any Gemini model id that supports generateContent, e.g. gemini-2.5-flash.

object-limit.name: Default object limit
object-limit.description: Max number of decoration objects the agent may place.

color-channel-start.name: First color channel used
color-channel-start.description: The agent uses up to 8 channels starting here. Pick unused ones.
